author: Abreu, P. and others
title: Search for lepton flavor number violating Z0 decays
abstract: A search for lepton flavour number violating Z0 decays in the channels Z0 -> mu tau, Z0 -> e tau, Z0 -> e mu, using the DELPHI detector with data collected during the 1991-94 LEP runs. No signal was found. Upper limits at 95% CL for the respective branching fractions of 1.2e-5, 2.2e-5, and 0.25e-5 were obtained.
